title: pm-eng-1on1-prep-avery-brooks
content:
Avery's 1:1 prep with Samir (eng lead) — goals: sync on API/Console changes, Dedicated capacity rollout, Private deployment timeline, and top technical risks.

Agenda (30m)
- quick wins / blockers (5m)
  - ask for status on the KV cache regression seen in staging (noticed higher p99 on small-requests).
  - confirm whether the nightly perf test is picking up the same pattern.
- Console UX changes + rollout plan (8m)
  - recap: modal-based flow for model pinning + per-route overrides (PR #842).
  - safety: canary strategy? want canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback if p95 latency > baseline +20% or error rate increases.
  - question: do we have metric hooks for route-level cost delta (tokens * quantization profile) to show to CS?
  - Dependencies: need a small API change to expose per-route cost estimate (backend PR queued).
- Hosted API / Dedicated pricing and capacity (7m)
  - product ask: make Dedicated offer visible in console (pricing + commit options).
  - engineering ask: estimated infra changes to support multi-tenant billing metadata and rate-limiting at the GPU pool level?
  - clarify expected timeline for quarterly sales demo (targeting mid-April).
- Private (VPC / on-prem) deployment updates (5m)
  - security checklist: KMS integration work outstanding (need HSM path documented).
  - ask Samir: blocker for on-prem packaging (is there DLL / binary signing issue?); estimate for GA internal docs.
- Risks & escalations (3m)
  - KV cache regression (priority P0 until root cause identified).
  - model-variant fallback path: make sure fallback doesn't exceed cost SLOs unexpectedly.

Notes / context (for me)
- Observed: staging perf dashboard spiked last Thursday; p99 latency increased from 220ms -> 410ms on small prompt tests. Might be cache miss rate increase. Metric: kv_cache_hit_rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.63.
- Linked tickets: JIRA-RED-1234 (kv-cache-investigation), JIRA-RED-1299 (console-model-pinning-ux), JIRA-RED-1305 (dedicated-billing-metadata).
- PRs: console PR #842 includes UI; backend change still pending.

Action items to confirm in 1:1
- Samir to confirm repro steps for KV cache regression and whether CI perf job can reproduce locally (owner: Samir; due: 2026-03-06).
- Engineering to add per-route cost estimate API (owner: backend team; ticket: JIRA-RED-1305; due: 2026-03-20).
- Agree on canary rollout policy for model-pinning console change and add automation for rollback (owner: eng-release + product; due: 2026-03-12).
- Private: get KMS/HSM integration doc updated and identify any blockers for on-prem packaging (owner: security + private-deployments infra; due: 2026-03-17).

Questions I want answered
- Is the KV cache regression isolated to a specific model family or a serving-runtime change?
- Can the nightly perf test be extended to include a small-requests workload (short prompt distribution)?
- Do we have an easy way to expose per-route cost delta in the console without shipping large infra changes? (temporary: show estimated token count * model unit cost).

Follow-up notes (post 1:1 - to fill during meeting)
- [ ] Repro steps for KV cache issue (fill here).
- [ ] Finalized canary percentages and rollback thresholds (fill here).
- [ ] Sprint ticket assignments for backend work and release-engineering tasks.
- [ ] Communication plan for CS + beta customers about Dedicated pricing visibility.

Quick personal reminders
- bring the 4-slide deck for sales demo to the meeting next week; include cost/latency tradeoff table.
- follow up with Riley on eval prompt set for regression tests.

Tone: keep it concise in meeting, push for clear owners and dates.

-- end of notes --
